summary.en: Conan and the Detective Boys are invited to "Smile Village" elderly facility. Suprisingly, the old women who live there are fans of the Detective Boys, and they are very rich. The Detective Boys then have suspicion on the owners. Location: Smile Village Victims: Azami Azagami, Botan Hotaka, Sumire Sumida and Sakura Sakuma Age: 77 years old (Azami and Sumire), 73 years old (Botan) and 78 years old (Sakura) Type: Nursing home scam Culprits: Tango Hohoemi, Waltz Hohoemi and Ondo Shibuzura (?) After seeing the owners' bizarre smiles, the Detective Boys decide to further investigate their whereabouts. While spying on them, they learn that the couple wants to use the old women's money that they are managing to buy resorts in Dubai.
